privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Reelbook is for keeping track of the movies and series you watch. This page explains, in plain words, what we keep, how it's used, and how to delete it.

sections.title: What we keep
sections.body: When you create an account: your email and password. The password is stored encrypted and nobody can read it. Your profile: name, username, bio, avatar and cover photos. Your diary: the movies and episodes you watched and when, your ratings, reviews, lists and watchlist.

sections.title: Where it's stored
sections.body: With an account, this data is stored on Supabase servers so it's the same on all your devices. A copy also stays on your phone. As a guest, nothing is sent to a server.

sections.title: Other services
sections.body: Movie and series information comes from TMDB. When you search, the query goes to TMDB without anything that identifies you. Streaming availability comes from JustWatch through TMDB. Trailers open on YouTube. Account emails are sent through an email provider.

sections.title: No ads, no tracking
sections.body: Reelbook has no ads, analytics or tracking tools. Your data isn't sold or shared with anyone. Your profile isn't shown to other users.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.body: New-episode reminders are scheduled on your phone. No data is sent to a server for them. You can turn them off in Settings at any time.

sections.title: Managing your data
sections.body: You can export your data to a file in Settings. Settings → Account → Delete account permanently removes your account and all your data from the server and your phone.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, the new version is published on this page and the date above is updated.
